langinfo.changes: 47 real C-locale metadata items (calendar names/formats, AM/PM, decimal point, empty thousands/currency), native nl_item 256..302; CODESET=1 retained
langinfo.lifetime: Immutable static strings with process lifetime; caller must not modify/free; no shared allocation
langinfo.locale: All accepted names retain C LC_TIME/numeric/monetary baseline. CODESET tracks LC_CTYPE; character conversion/classification implementations unchanged.
langinfo.error: Unknown items including integer extremes and original reserved 2 return empty without changing errno
langinfo.tests: All names, formats, abbreviations, invalid items, errno, UTF8 selection, stable pointers and four concurrent readers; 1/2/4 CPUs

calendar.reason: tm/timeval definitions, calendar conversion/strftime/timezone APIs remain absent. Returning format metadata does not implement calendar execution.

environment.existing: getenv exposes immutable process-lifetime startup envp bytes; Rust borrows are static; native std owns its own mutex-protected mutable snapshot (tools/native-std/overlay/env/sunlightos.rs); its Rust setenv/unsetenv do not update libc envp
environment.reason: An owned shared registry, synchronization, inherited child snapshot integration and borrow/mutable-storage rules are required. Freeing or mutating current static Rust borrows would be unsound. Naive permanent-copy leakage is not a cleanup contract.
environment.native_tests: Existing startup environment/locale-selection probes reexecuted; mutable environment ownership/concurrency tests NOT_RUN without implementation

buffering.existing: Native stdio performs actual unbuffered I/O. setvbuf(_IONBF) works; full/line modes fail ENOSYS; invalid mode EINVAL; setbuf never retains user buffer.
buffering.missing: Real pending-output/input buffers and flush/seek/close/exit integration with stream locking and ownership rules
buffering.tests: Existing PY3 stream-policy and PY2 real stdio/format probes reexecuted; buffered mode behavior NOT_RUN without implementation
